name: Spell crafting (Codex)
author: Wizard
summary: Characters learn new spells by combining spells they already know, from recipes in the Codex.

approval.label: Who approves a crafted spell
approval.help: dm: the DM approves each one; auto: learned at once when the recipe fits.

rules.text: A character can learn a new spell by combining spells they already know, following a recipe in the Codex.

assistant.player: To help a player craft: read their codex with my_spell_codex (the spells they know), then list_spell_recipes for recipes; say which recipes they can make now and what each one still needs. Read a spell with read_spell before describing it. A crafted spell waits for the DM unless the DM set approval to auto.
assistant.dm: To help the DM with spell crafting: list_spell_recipes shows the recipes and draft_spell_recipe proposes a new one (the DM approves it). When a player asks to craft, check they know every spell the recipe needs.
